customer_actors: Authored synthetic customer role tokens; not invented real people or external messages.

synthetic_terms.permitted_use: Only customer-directed, minimized routing of nonpersonal logical-PHI tokens under an explicit customer decision and a separate Sable Harbor counsel gate; no independent AI reuse, unrelated marketing or discretionary sale.
synthetic_terms.customer_reserved_decisions: Customer retains its covered-entity decisions, individual preference/authorization ledger, clinical professional judgment, restriction acceptance and termination instructions, and de-identification/limited-data-set determinations.
synthetic_terms.sable_harbor_duties: Sable Harbor independently validates contract purpose, release authority, current authorization/restriction state, route conditions, recipient identity, minimized scope, endpoint protection and after-receipt use/retention. It holds requests when any gate is unresolved.
synthetic_terms.subcontractor: The new restricted token scope uses the prospectively executed fictional downstream chain; no independent reuse and no retroactive cure of the prior late-flowdown marker incident.
synthetic_terms.records_and_retention: Token records remain until 2027-10-31 pending customer disposition; backup copies remain until 2027-11-30; privacy-decision records remain through 2033-09-30. Legal holds override scheduled disposition. These are fictional contract choices, not assertions of a universal HIPAA medical-record retention period.
synthetic_terms.incident_path: Security reconciles decisions and deliveries, pauses routing on authority mismatch, and asks Legal and the customer to evaluate return, remediation and simulated notification obligations. An OPEN incident remains OPEN until actual source versions support closure.
synthetic_terms.real_data: No personal or medical payloads, actual signatures, real external messages, actual legal authority or operating deployments are created. Business dates are 2027 simulation clocks; imported_at is actual insertion time.
